subject: Private Plan term amendment & evidence for procurement review
messages:
From: Anika Rao <anika.rao@cumulusfin.com>
To: michael_grant@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@cumulusfin.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private plan — request for term adjustments & evidence

Hi Michael / Lauren,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Procurement at Cumulus is ready to move forward with a private plan, but they flagged two items that need to be clarified before legal signs off: 

1) A short-term SLA exception for first 60 days (onboarding ramp) that would relax the latency SLA by 30% for burst traffic tied to our migration window.
2) Required evidence: a brief SOC 2 summary, a diagram of the private deployment isolation, and an updated DPA with specific data deletion timelines.

I've attached a one-page request form ("Cumulus_SLA_Exception_Request.pdf"). Can you confirm whether Redwood can: (a) commit to a 60-day onboarding exception language, and (b) provide the SOC 2 summary + diagram this week? Also loop in legal if needed.

Goal: get terms finalized by EOW so procurement can route to finance.

Thanks,
Anika Rao
Director, Strategic Procurement
Cumulus Financial

From: michael_grant@redwoodinference.com
To: Anika Rao <anika.rao@cumulusfin.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, irene_choi@redwoodinference.com, procurement@cumulusfin.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private plan — request for term adjustments & evidence

Anika — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: we can accept a constrained onboarding SLA exception for 60 days (with metric gates and a rollback clause), and we have the SOC 2 executive summary + isolation diagram ready. 

Irene, looping in Legal to confirm the precise amendment language and to attach an updated DPA draft. Lauren, can you confirm if we want to offer any onboarding credits in lieu of stricter SLA? Procurement often accepts a small credit vs permanent SLA changes.

Next steps I propose:
- Legal (Irene) to draft a 1-paragraph amendment capturing the 60-day exception + rollback triggers.
- I will upload SOC2 summary, deployment isolation diagram, and updated DPA v2 to the shared Drive and send DocuSign link for the amendment.

Anika — expect the docs by EOD today. If finance needs a formal PO path, tell me the contact and I'll route.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0197

Attachment stubs: redwood-evidence-soc2-summary.pdf, private-deploy-isolation-diagram.svg

From: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
To: michael_grant@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Anika Rao <anika.rao@cumulusfin.com>, procurement@cumulusfin.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private plan — request for term adjustments & evidence

Michael / Lauren / Anika — drafting amendment now. Draft outline below (will convert to formal exhibit):

- 60-day Onboarding Exception: For the first sixty (60) days following activation of the Private Plan, Redwood will permit a temporary relaxation of the Service Level Objective for 99th-percentile token latency by up to 30% during defined migration windows, provided that (i) Customer provides a 72-hour notice prior to any planned bulk migration window, and (ii) Redwood’s incident response SLA remains unchanged.
- Gates & Rollback: If error rates exceed 5% or sustained latency > 2x baseline outside planned windows for more than 2 hours, Redwood may suspend the exception and revert to standard SLA.
- Credits: No automatic credits during exception period; one-time onboarding credit of $10,000 available if production issues attributable to Redwood cause > 12 hours of sustained degraded availability during the 60-day window.
- Evidence & DPA: Attach SOC 2 executive summary, isolation diagram, and DPA v2. Data deletion timelines: 30 days for ephemeral KV caches, 90 days for stored logs unless otherwise recorded in the DPA.

Anika — does this capture the ask? If yes I will turn into an exhibit and attach to the DocuSign packet.

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Compliance & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: Anika Rao <anika.rao@cumulusfin.com>
To: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com, michael_grant@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@cumulusfin.com
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private plan — request for term adjustments & evidence

Irene — this looks good and aligns with our internal risk appetite. Two quick clarifications: 
1) On the credit: can you confirm whether the $10k is a credit against monthly usage or a one-time invoice credit? We prefer a usage credit that applies within the first billing cycle after activation.
2) Data deletion: Cumulus requires a 60-day maximum for stored logs (we have a short retention policy). Can you change 90 days to 60 days for stored logs?

If you can make those two changes, procurement will approve and we can route the amendment to our CFO for signature. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Anika

From: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
To: Anika Rao <anika.rao@cumulusfin.com>, michael_grant@redwoodinference.com, lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@cumulusfin.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private plan — request for term adjustments & evidence

Anika — updated and finalized. Summary of changes: 

- $10,000 onboarding credit to be applied as a usage credit on the first billing statement following activation.
- Stored logs retention reduced to 60 days in the DPA exhibit.
- Final amendment exhibit attached and sent via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/ABC123456789
- Evidence uploaded to shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cPrivatePlanOnboard

Please confirm if Cumulus accepts the exhibit as-is and we will initiate the DocuSign flow today.

Thanks all — quick turn on this one.

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Compliance & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: Redwood_PrivatePlan_DPA_v2.docx, redwood-evidence-soc2-summary.pdf
